units.source_text: 另一个女人却瞧也不瞧阿泷一眼，只说了声“晚上好”，就一声不响地像酣睡过去了。

en.t: The other woman did not even glance at Otaki; she only said, "Good evening," and then fell silent, as if she had sunk into a deep sleep.

units.source_text: 她睫眉深黛，衬着两只明亮的眼睛。

en.t: Her lashes and brows were darkly shaded, setting off her two bright eyes.

units.source_text: 桃瓣形的发髻像抹过油似的，浓密光滑，斜垂下来。

en.t: Her peach-petal-shaped coiffure, as though smoothed with oil, was thick and glossy, and hung down at a slant.

units.source_text: 白皙的扁平脸露出一副朦胧的睡相……

en.t: Her fair, flat face wore a dim, drowsy expression...

units.source_text: 在她这张睡脸上，镶嵌着两片蓓蕾般的芳唇和长长的睫毛，

en.t: Set into that sleeping face were two bud-like lovely lips and long eyelashes,

units.source_text: 像是另一种有生命的东西，鲜明地浮现出来。

en.t: standing out vividly, as if they were another kind of living thing.

units.source_text: 眉毛未加修饰，自然蓬乱地长着。

en.t: Her eyebrows had not been shaped; they grew in a naturally tousled way.

units.source_text: 无论是耳朵、颈项还是手指，任何一个部分，只要你看上一眼，

en.t: Whether it was her ears, the nape of her neck, or her fingers, any part of her, once you looked at it,

units.source_text: 牙齿就觉得发痒，简直想咬一口。

en.t: made your teeth itch, until you almost wanted to bite it.

units.source_text: 这种温柔之感，使阿泷马上意识到她大概就是阿笑。

en.t: This sense of softness made Otaki realize at once that she was probably O-Shō.
